guide.summary: Chinese prepositions (coverbs) such as 在, 给, 跟, 对, 从, 离, 往, 用 set the scene for the action: where, with whom, to whom, from where, with what. The scene comes first, so the coverb phrase stands BEFORE the verb, not after it as in English. Only a place or person that the action ends up at (放在, 送到, 寄给) follows the verb.

subs.label: Coverb phrase before the verb
subs.focus: Force the learner to place the 在 / 跟 / 和 / 给 phrase between the subject (and time word) and the verb. Classic mistake: English order with the phrase at the end (我吃饭在家, 我见面朋友). Mostly order and judge items; do not use 住 or other verbs that also allow the phrase after them.

subs.label: Where 不, 没, 也, 都 and modals go
subs.focus: Force the choice of slot for 不 / 没 / 也 / 都 / 常常 / 想 / 要 relative to the coverb phrase. With action verbs they go before the coverb (没给他打电话, not 给他没打电话). With adjective-type predicates (对…好, 离…远, 跟…一样, 对…感兴趣) 不 and 很 go on the predicate (对我不好, 离这儿不远). Classic mistake: mixing the two up.

subs.label: 从 vs 离 (and 从…到)
subs.focus: Force the choice between 从 (starting point of movement or of a time span, often paired with 到) and 离 (the distance or time gap between two points, followed by 远 / 近 / 有 + amount / 还有). Classic mistake: 我家从学校很远, because both translate as 'from'.

subs.label: 对 vs 跟 / 和 vs 给
subs.focus: Choose the coverb from the predicate: 对 for attitude or effect (对我很好, 对…感兴趣, 对身体好); 跟 / 和 for mutual acts (见面, 聊天, 结婚, 商量); 给 for a recipient (打电话, 写信, 介绍, 买). Classic mistakes: 跟音乐感兴趣, 对他打电话. Never set 跟 against 和, or 跟他说 against 对他说 (both fine).

subs.label: 往 vs 向 vs 朝
subs.focus: Choose among 往, 向, 朝: 往 needs a direction or place plus a movement verb (往左拐); 向 and 朝 can take a person; only 向 goes with abstract verbs (向他学习, 向你道歉). Classic mistakes: 往他学习, 往我笑. Never set 向 against 朝, or any of the three against each other in 往 / 向 / 朝前走.

subs.label: 为 and 替
subs.focus: Force 为 for the person behind a feeling or service (为你高兴, 为他担心, 为大家服务) and 替 for acting in someone's place (替我去开会, 替我向他问好). Classic mistake: 对你高兴, or the phrase after the verb. Never set 替 against 给 in favours where both work (替我买 / 给我买).

subs.label: 用 (tool) and 坐 (transport)
subs.focus: Force 用 + tool and 坐 + vehicle before the main verb (用筷子吃饭, 坐地铁去上班), and the choice of 用 / 坐 / 骑. Classic mistakes: 用地铁去, 坐自行车. Test order with order and rewrite items; do not write judge items calling 我去上班坐地铁 wrong, since it can occur in contrast.

subs.label: 在 / 到 / 给 after the verb
subs.focus: Force 在 / 到 / 给 directly after a placement or transfer verb when the phrase says where the thing ends up: 放在, 坐在, 写在, 挂在; 送到, 搬到; 寄给, 送给, 交给, 发给, 还给. Usually with 把 for a definite object. Classic mistakes: 我放书在桌子上, 我送他在机场 for 送到机场.

rules.rule: Where an activity happens goes before the verb: 在 + place, then the action.

examples.py: wǒ zài jiā chī fàn
examples.en: I eat at home.

examples.py: tā zài tú shū guǎn kàn shū
examples.en: He is reading in the library.

examples.zh: 我们中午在公司附近吃饭。
examples.py: wǒ men zhōng wǔ zài gōng sī fù jìn chī fàn
examples.en: We eat near the office at noon.

rules.note: A few verbs of staying in a position, above all 住, allow both orders: 我住在北京 and 我在北京住 are both correct.

rules.rule: The person you do something with comes before the verb with 跟 or 和; 一起 follows that phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 跟 / 和 + person + (一起) + Verb

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn péng you jiàn miàn
examples.en: I'm meeting a friend tomorrow.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng hé nǐ liáo tiān
examples.en: I'd like to chat with you.

examples.zh: 她周末跟同学一起去看电影。
examples.py: tā zhōu mò gēn tóng xué yī qǐ qù kàn diàn yǐng
examples.en: She is going to see a film with classmates at the weekend.

rules.note: 见面, 聊天, 结婚 cannot take the other person as an object: never 见面朋友 or 结婚他.

rules.rule: The tool (用) or the vehicle (坐) is stated first, then what you do with it.
rules.pattern: Subject + 用 + tool + Verb / Subject + 坐 + vehicle + 去 / 来 / 上班 …

examples.py: zhōng guó rén yòng kuài zi chī fàn
examples.en: Chinese people eat with chopsticks.

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò dì tiě shàng bān
examples.en: I go to work by subway every day.

examples.py: nǐ kě yǐ yòng shǒu jī fù qián
examples.en: You can pay with your phone.

rules.note: Bicycles take 骑 (骑自行车去), and driving yourself is 开车去. The reversed order (我去上班坐地铁) only appears in special contrastive contexts; treat the tool-first order as the rule.

rules.rule: With an action verb, 不, 没, 也, 都, 常常 and modal verbs (想, 要, 能, 可以) go before the coverb, not before the main verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 不 / 没 / 也 / 都 / modal + coverb + noun + Verb

examples.py: wǒ bù zài jiā chī wǎn fàn
examples.en: I don't eat dinner at home.

examples.py: tā zuó tiān méi gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: He didn't call me yesterday.

examples.py: wǒ yě xiǎng gēn nǐ men yī qǐ qù
examples.en: I want to go with you too.

rules.rule: When the predicate is an adjective or a state (好, 远, 近, 一样, 感兴趣), 不 and 很 go on that predicate, after the coverb phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 对 / 离 / 跟 + noun + 不 / 很 + adjective

examples.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào bù yuǎn
examples.en: My home is not far from school.

examples.py: wǒ duì zú qiú bù gǎn xìng qù
examples.en: I'm not interested in football.

examples.py: wǒ de xiǎng fǎ gēn nǐ bù yī yàng
examples.en: My idea is different from yours.

rules.note: 也 and 都 still go before the coverb here: 他对我也很好.

rules.rule: 从 marks the point where movement or a period starts; 到 marks where it ends.

examples.zh: 从北京到上海要五个小时。
examples.py: cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi yào wǔ gè xiǎo shí
examples.en: It takes five hours from Beijing to Shanghai.

examples.py: tā gāng cóng gōng sī huí lai
examples.en: He has just come back from the office.

examples.py: wǒ men cóng bā diǎn kāi shǐ shàng kè
examples.en: We start class at eight.

rules.rule: 离 measures the gap between two points in space or time. Nothing moves; it is followed by 远, 近, 有 + distance, or 还有 + time.
rules.pattern: A + 离 + B + 很远 / 很近 / 有 + distance / 还有 + time

examples.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn
examples.en: My home is close to school.

examples.zh: 这儿离机场有二十公里。
examples.py: zhè r lí jī chǎng yǒu èr shí gōng lǐ
examples.en: It is twenty kilometres from here to the airport.

examples.py: lí kǎo shì hái yǒu sān tiān
examples.en: There are still three days until the exam.

rules.rule: 对 marks the target of an attitude, a feeling or an effect.
rules.pattern: Subject + 对 + noun + 很 + adjective / 感兴趣 / 有帮助

examples.py: lǎo shī duì wǒ men hěn hǎo
examples.en: The teacher is very good to us.

examples.zh: 他对中国历史很感兴趣。
examples.py: tā duì zhōng guó lì shǐ hěn gǎn xìng qù
examples.en: He is very interested in Chinese history.

examples.py: duō hē shuǐ duì shēn tǐ hǎo
examples.en: Drinking more water is good for your health.

rules.rule: 跟 / 和 marks a partner in something mutual; 给 marks the person who receives a call, a message, a thing or a service.
rules.pattern: 跟 / 和 + person + 见面 / 聊天 / 商量 / 结婚 ; 给 + person + 打电话 / 写信 / 发邮件 / 介绍 / 买

examples.py: wǒ wǎn shang gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà
examples.en: I'll call you tonight.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ shāng liang yī jiàn shì
examples.en: I'd like to discuss something with you.

examples.zh: 请给我们介绍一下这个地方。
examples.py: qǐng gěi wǒ men jiè shào yī xià zhè ge dì fang
examples.en: Please tell us a bit about this place.

rules.note: With 说 both 跟他说 and 对他说 are standard (给他说 is regional). 打电话给他 is also heard, but 给他打电话 is the default order.

rules.rule: 往 takes a direction or place and a verb of movement. 向 and 朝 can also face a person, and only 向 is used with abstract verbs such as 学习, 道歉, 问好, 介绍.
rules.pattern: 往 + direction + movement verb ; 向 / 朝 + person + Verb ; 向 + person + 学习 / 道歉

examples.py: dào le lù kǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi
examples.en: Turn left when you get to the junction.

examples.py: nǐ yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu jiù dào le
examples.en: Just keep walking straight ahead and you'll be there.

examples.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng tā xué xí
examples.en: We should learn from him.

examples.py: tā cháo wǒ xiào le xiào
examples.en: She gave me a smile.

rules.note: For plain physical direction the three overlap: 往前走, 向前走 and 朝前走 are all correct. 朝 stresses facing a direction and is the most colloquial.

rules.rule: 为 names the person or cause you feel something for or serve; 替 means doing it in that person's place.
rules.pattern: Subject + 为 + person + 高兴 / 担心 / 服务 ; Subject + 替 + person + Verb

examples.py: wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng
examples.en: I'm really happy for you.

examples.py: bié wèi wǒ dān xīn
examples.en: Don't worry about me.

examples.py: nǐ néng tì wǒ qù kāi huì ma
examples.en: Can you go to the meeting in my place?

examples.py: qǐng tì wǒ xiàng tā wèn hǎo
examples.en: Please say hello to him for me.

rules.note: For everyday favours 给 and 替 often both work (给我买一杯咖啡 / 替我买一杯咖啡); 替 adds the idea 'so that I don't have to'.

rules.rule: If the phrase says where the thing or person ends up as a result of the action, 在 / 到 / 给 attaches right after the verb; a definite object moves forward with 把.
rules.pattern: 把 + object + 放 / 写 + 在 + place ; 送 / 搬 + 到 + place ; 寄 / 发 / 交 + 给 + person

examples.py: qǐng bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
examples.en: Please put the book on the table.

examples.py: wǒ bǎ tā sòng dào jī chǎng le
examples.en: I took him to the airport.

examples.py: wǒ bǎ zhào piàn fā gěi nǐ le
examples.en: I've sent you the photos.

examples.py: nǐ zuò zài zhè r ba
examples.en: Sit here.

rules.note: Compare: 我在桌子上写字 (the writing happens at the table) and 把名字写在书上 (the name ends up on the book). Nothing may come between the verb and 在 / 到 / 给, and 了 follows the whole unit.

contrasts.why: The place of an activity is scene-setting, so 在家 must stand before 吃饭. English puts 'at home' last; Chinese does not.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān gēn péng you jiàn miàn

contrasts.why: 见面 cannot take an object. The other person is introduced with 跟 or 和 before the verb.

right.py: wǒ méi gěi tā dǎ diàn huà

contrasts.why: With an action verb, 没 and 不 go before the coverb phrase, not between it and the verb.

right.en: He is not nice to me.

contrasts.why: 好 is an adjective predicate, so 不 goes directly on it, after 对我. The same holds for 离…不远 and 跟…不一样.

right.py: wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn yuǎn
right.en: My home is far from school.

contrasts.why: Distance between two points is 离. 从 is only for a starting point of movement or time.

contrasts.wrong: 离北京到上海要五个小时。

right.zh: 从北京到上海要五个小时。
right.py: cóng běi jīng dào shàng hǎi yào wǔ gè xiǎo shí
right.en: It takes five hours from Beijing to Shanghai.

contrasts.why: A route with a start and an end is 从…到. 离 does not pair with 到.

right.py: wǒ duì yīn yuè hěn gǎn xìng qù

contrasts.why: Interest is an attitude toward something, so it takes 对. 跟 is for a partner in a mutual activity.

right.py: wǒ men yīng gāi xiàng tā xué xí

contrasts.why: 往 needs a direction or place and real movement. With a person and an abstract verb like 学习, only 向 works.

right.py: wǒ bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le
right.en: I put the book on the table.

contrasts.why: The table is where the book ends up, so 在 attaches directly to 放. The object cannot sit between them; it moves forward with 把.

right.py: wǒ zhēn wèi nǐ gāo xìng

contrasts.why: Feeling something on someone's account takes 为. 对 would point the feeling at the person, which 高兴 does not allow.

cheat: Where, with whom, to whom, with what: say it BEFORE the verb.
不 / 没 / 也 / 都 / 想 go before the coverb with action verbs; 不 and 很 go on the adjective (对我不好, 离这儿不远).
How far or how long until? 离. Starting point, often with 到? 从.
Attitude or effect: 对. Doing it together: 跟 / 和. Someone receives it: 给.
往 + direction + movement. Person plus 学习 / 道歉 / 问好: 向.
Happy or worried for someone: 为. In someone's place: 替.
The thing ends up there: 放在, 送到, 寄给 after the verb, usually with 把.
